designRead: An editorial portfolio extending the approved airy blue-grey homepage, with tactile artwork and rare saturated warmth.
foundation: Eleventy and Nunjucks, native CSS, self-hosted Manrope throughout, Geist Mono for code and data, and shared blue gray color tokens. Refined through landing-page-design; see landing-page-refinement.json.

preserved: Published heading IDs and deep links
The authored Unwind explainer include and its discovery hook
replaced: Fixed fading navigation on interior pages
Dense timeline before the project collection
Narrow legacy project header with loose typography
audit.seo: Page-specific titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, Open Graph and Twitter image fallbacks, and a branded favicon. Search ranking was not measured.

pages.projects: Expanded paper-paths masthead, full project timeline open at the top with a fitted overview and two-axis zoom, followed by category navigation, full-topic search, and project cards with child links.
pages.publications: Paper-strata masthead, year groups, working All / Papers / Patents filters, publication authors and venue metadata.
pages.about: Ginkgo masthead, portrait and introduction, readable biography sections, publications, education and contact.
pages.projectTemplate: Project summary and links, facts, optional real image or video, build-time section navigation, readable long-form content, related projects and gallery.
pages.authoredExplainers: External compatibility styles and navigation derived from existing section IDs; the source include remains independent.
pages.secondary: Tag collections and both custom 404 routes use the same shell.

verification.build: 132 pages, internal links, anchors, media and static resources verified.
verification.tests: All 8 existing tests passed; none skipped.
functional: Timeline scroll stays within the component
verification.performance: Artwork optimised to WebP (73,328 / 85,156 / 138,938 bytes). No Lighthouse audit was run.
